items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Oh, Al Sear's Band. ... Yes. They hired me over there.

ctx.x: But you didn't tell me what band that was.

items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, and they just played and I just sang, and we had a good time.

ctx.x: I don't know. I sang a lot of songs. I sang little ballads, you know. I don't remember any of the songs that I sang.
And you told Al sears what key you were going to sing in and so on?
Yeah, and they just played and I just sang, and we had a good time.
